summary: EFCAR, LLC (depositor/registrant) and Exeter Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-3 (issuing entity) filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement and related documents for a term securitization of sub-prime auto loans. On June 16, 2026, EFCAR and Exeter Finance LLC entered into an underwriting agreement with Wells Fargo, Barclays, and J.P. Morgan for the sale of eight classes of asset-backed notes totaling approximately $1.29 billion. The transaction is a routine ABS shelf takedown involving the transfer of receivables from Exeter to the trust. No special-situation elements (e.g., merger, tender, activist, restructuring) are present; the filing solely describes a standard securitization issuance.
